evidence.source: Contracts 191 to 198 applied to Development on 18 August 2026 through the ADR 0024 fast lane, run 32119101708, from exact main 3dfe441809b41b7a5a3531d0ee4544e3a0235bc8. All eight were proven additive by scripts/check-migration-additive.mjs before the apply. CONFIRMED BY AN INDEPENDENT READ-ONLY QUERY RATHER THAN FROM THE JOB OUTPUT, naming the ledger row: 198 rows with newest 20260818030000 cup_knockout_reservation. The immediately preceding boundary is corrected in the same movement. This record previously claimed 189 while hosted Development already held 190, and no workflow run in this repository applied that contract - the fast lane before this one is 31751114401 of 13 August, cited for 189, and development-migration-rollout.yml has never run. Contract 190 therefore reached Development by a route this repository does not record, and that remains unexplained rather than backfilled. EVERY PLAYER-OWNED COUNT IS UNCHANGED ACROSS THE APPLY, each compared against a measurement taken before it: 24 auth users, 24 profiles, 34 entries, 64 season predictions, 756 match predictions, 8 settled matchweek scores, 20 competition entrants, 0 bonus score events, 5 leagues, 39 league members, 1 Cup launch, 112 Cup fixtures and 578 season fixtures. Euro publication is still hidden, cron holds 14 jobs, and PAID COLLECTION REMAINS DISABLED with ai.api_usage still 0. CUSTODY WAS VERIFIED ON THE INSTALLED DEFINITIONS. All five new reads - resolve_season_player, get_season_rank_history, get_season_rivalry, get_season_cup_bracket and get_my_football_calendar - are executable by authenticated and by no anonymous role; get_my_football_calendar leaks to no PUBLIC, anon or service_role grantee; and the two action generators and cup_knockout_rounds are executable by NOBODY, with zero grants of any kind. THE IN-PLACE PATCHING ORDER SURVIVED, all four present at once on the installed functions: contract 102 split-safety and initial-roster pinning, contract 194 eligibility, contract 196 outcome dating on both the elimination and champion writes and on the finalise authority, and contract 198 depth authority. process_player_action_items now calls four generators where it called two. CONTRACT 198 ANSWERS ON THE LIVE DATABASE: 70 qualifiers need 7 rounds, a hundred entrants over 38 matchweeks reserve exactly those 7, and ten entrants over 38 reserve none. The one launched Championship is unaffected. It is private, tournament-scoped, format_kind single_group, 8 entrants, 112 fixtures, and still entirely in its group stage, so admin_finalise_predictor_cup_groups has not run on it. Its 8 entrants send 6 qualifiers and the extracted authority returns 3 rounds - the same bracket the pre-198 inline arithmetic gives, which the migration itself asserts for every qualifier count from 1 to 300 as a precondition of applying. player_action_items stood at 9 immediately after the apply, unchanged, because the generators run from the player-action-centre-generate cron job on a */15 schedule rather than at apply time. This is database state only and claims no application publication.
